spellbook.finance/limitations: Demand behavior and actor fields are omitted. Existing demand behavior remains server-owned.
A saved amendment read does not prove a listing changed or trigger repricing.

description: Read one saved pricing amendment's selector, marketplace scope, absolute multiplier, optional protected band, enabled state, priority and timestamps. Use it before an update, preview or delete.

amendmentId.description: The exact saved amendment id from a prior amendment read. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.
